01 / About

More than code.

A concise look at the foundation, mindset, and direction behind my work.

I’m a Computer Science & Engineering undergraduate building a strong foundation in programming, problem solving, algorithms, data structures, and core computer science concepts.

I learn best by building. I enjoy turning ideas into working projects, experimenting with different technologies, and understanding what makes a solution clear, useful, and reliable.

My current direction is software development, with a growing focus on modern web technologies, practical project building, and intelligent systems. I value logical thinking, continuous learning, and improving through every project I take on.
